summary.name: Freeter
summary.one_liner: Freeter is a free, open-source desktop organizer that gathers apps, web pages, files, notes and to-do lists into project-based workflow screens.
keywords: organize apps links and files by project
use_cases: organize apps, links and files per project
switch between work projects without distraction
open project files in an editor with one click
run frequently used terminal commands from a button
summary.what_it_does: Freeter lets you build workflow screens containing widgets for web pages, project file openers, templated web queries, to-do lists, terminal command buttons, countdown timers and notes. You select a project from a drop-down menu to limit what you see to that project. Large projects can be split into multiple workflows navigated by tabs, and a Shelf keeps items such as a timer visible across all projects and workflows. The webpage widget can keep different accounts signed in per project, workflow or widget. The app is available for Linux, Windows and Mac OS, and a Ctrl or Cmd+Shift+F hotkey brings it up from anywhere.
notable: Widgets for web pages, file opening, web queries, to-dos, terminal commands, timers and notes
Project drop-down that isolates work by project and workflow
No telemetry or usage tracking; GNU GPL open source
Global hotkey Ctrl or Cmd+Shift+F to access from anywhere
caveats: The page does not state pricing details beyond being free and open source under GPL.
Default light theme; dark theme must be switched on manually.
